name: STT_Benchmark2.0
description: STT_Benchmark2.0 is a speech-to-text benchmark that measures automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance across a variety of recorded audio conditions and speakers. It evaluates transcription accuracy and robustness to noise, accents, and recording quality. The benchmark is intended to compare ASR systems on real-world audio and to surface failure modes in transcription pipelines.
reputation: A community-hosted Hugging Face dataset for ASR evaluation with modest adoption, useful for researchers testing robustness across audio conditions.
